# Church4Christ

> Church4Christ is open-source church management software (ChMS) and a church CMS with a bilingual English/Chinese church website. It is a self-hosted, modular alternative to hosted church platforms such as Planning Center, built with Astro on Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare D1 or Supabase/PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare R2. License: GPL-3.0. Source: https://github.com/leveo/church4christ. Demo: https://church4christ.yunfei-song.com.

It is intended for small and mid-size churches, fellowships, and nonprofits, especially bilingual and immigrant congregations, that have a technically comfortable person or partner to deploy and maintain it. It is source code you host, not a managed service.

Implemented capabilities: public church website with three themes, sermons, bulletins, events, articles, testimonies, and a drag-and-drop page builder; people and households with CSV import and export; groups and fellowships; volunteer scheduling with email confirmation; children's check-in kiosk; service attendance; newcomer follow-up; prayer wall; community workflows with email reminders; multi-campus; activity scores; a Learning module connected to Google Classroom or Canvas; optional member portal, offline giving ledger, and free event registration (Supabase backend); optional read-only Planning Center People synchronization.

Not included: native mobile apps, SMS messaging, and worship service or song planning. Online card giving and paid registration through Stripe are preview/test-only.
